suggestions.pitch: Nabers projects at zero, so packaging him with Hopkins for McCaffrey and Kittle gives me two weekly starters from a 2-4 rebuilding partner.
Nabers alone brings back McCaffrey and Kelce, both starters, and the 2-4 partner is in a position to sell.
Nabers for Rashee Rice and Gadsden adds a starting WR and TE for the rest of the season.
